sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding a five-game winning streak, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Alsager arrive in poor form with only one win in their last ten matches and sit bottom of the division with just 4 points, making this an opportunity for Sandbach to extend their excellent run and maintain their lead.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face Dawley Town away, with Stafford looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after a recent draw. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth visit Eccleshall in a mid-table clash, while Wolverhampton Casuals (4th) travel to Wednesfield Community (9th) in another fixture between sides in contrasting form. Bilston Town (6th) host Foley Meir (13th) in a battle between a resurgent side and a struggling outfit. Barnton (7th) welcome Shawbury United (15th), while New Mills (8th) host Market Drayton Town (10th) in a lower-mid-table encounter. Brereton Social (14th) face Widnes Town (20th), the division's bottom club on just 2 points. Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th) travel to Telford Town (18th) in a fixture between two of the division's poorest-performing sides. Finally, Crewe (16th) host Allscott Heath (11th) in another relegation-form battle.
